notes:
Planning Center Sync 0.10.3: security fixes

- Any HTML in an event's name or location is removed as it arrives from
  Planning Center.
- Pictures are only taken from Planning Center.
- The Settings screen now explains that the token can do whatever its
  Planning Center person can.
- When the website has file editing switched off (SiteGround Security's
  "Disable Themes & Plugins Editor"), the code pages can be read and copied
  but not saved.
- Updates are only taken from the exact release address.
